topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I just found out someone got a tattoo of my artwork. It's on their arm, of all places. My designs, inked on skin. I didn't know what to think at first. It's not like I’ve never seen my work out there, but this is different. It's permanent for them, and they chose my art. I guess it shows they really connected with it. I can't decide if I should be flattered or if I should be worried about where else my work might end up. Either way, I can't help but wonder how many other people might have done the same.
